description: This file defines an Angular service class 'QueuesTableConfigResolver' that configures and resolves table settings for displaying and managing queues in the admin UI of the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: QueuesTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An Angular injectable service that provides configuration and resolution logic for the queues table in the admin UI, including column setup, entity actions, and navigation.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the table configuration as an observable, setting up columns and entity functions.

methods.name: configureColumns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the queues table, including name, partitions, submit strategy, and processing strategy.

methods.name: configureEntityFunctions
methods.description: Sets up functions for fetching, loading, saving, and deleting queue entities, as well as enabling/disabling selection and deletion.

methods.name: onQueueAction
methods.description: Handles actions performed on queue entities, such as opening a queue.

methods.name: openQueue
methods.description: Navigates to the specific queue details page when the 'open' action is triggered.
